prompt: Create one original square 2x2 source sheet for a premium sci-fi RTS military outpost material set. Each quadrant is a separate perfectly top-down orthographic material swatch, filling its quadrant edge-to-edge with no frame, no gap, no labels, no text, no logos, no objects, no buildings, no perspective, and neutral flat studio lighting with no baked directional shadows. Top-left: cool charcoal gunmetal roof deck with broad modular armor plates, restrained recessed panel seams, tiny fasteners, subtle brushed grain, readable at 50-100 pixels. Top-right: cool blue-grey reinforced composite facade with large coherent bays, sparse bevels and clean inset service access lines, no windows and no white/chalk concrete. Bottom-left: dark service vent and louvre material with a small number of broad vents, heat-darkened but clean, no grime blobs. Bottom-right: reinforced trim/edge material with long dark structural rails, restrained hazard-yellow micro accents under 5 percent of area, no stripes dominating the tile. AAA real-time strategy PBR source-art quality, crisp medium-scale detail, strong material separation, subtle microtexture, no photogrammetry clutter, no rust, no brown dirt, no giant square stamps. Every quadrant should be designed to become seamless/tileable after deterministic periodic baking, with matching color and feature flow near its own opposite edges. This must be wholly original and not imitate or copy any existing game asset.
bake: 8px source inset, Lanczos to 512, half-period wrap with 48px cosine seam correction, wrapped central-difference tangent normals

channels.nre: RG tangent normal XY, B roughness, A emissive
channels.masks: R metallic, GB reserved/team masks, A edge response
